pincaimao-interview-reports v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides interview report and coaching material generation using Pincaimao Interview Report API.
- Requires PCM_INTERVIEW_REPORT_KEY and supports Bash, curl, and Python3.
- Includes detailed usage guide, parameter differences, error handling, and output modes.
- Emphasizes security by only transmitting data to api.pincaimao.com and never storing or logging user data elsewhere.
